paperA.description: Red paper in the lobe and checker cells; red ink printed on white cells is paper B.

paperB.description: White paper in its shaded lobe and checker cells, including red printed hearts and black ink outlines. Handles, seams and uncertain physical boundaries are excluded.

review.note: Native photograph and publisher patterns establish red printed hearts and dark ink outlines on white paper. Four conservative white-cell interiors add material B supervision across ink. Existing paper A and B polygons and body uncertainty remain unchanged. Source, native polygon overlay and compiled 256- and 768-pixel overlays visually reviewed. No model has trained on this revision; previous training inputs and predictions remain preserved.

paperA.description: Floral printed material: turquoise ground and every flower, leaf and printed colour on that same material; physical paper/fabric composition is unverified.

paperB.description: Horizontally striped printed material, including all its white, green, blue, yellow, orange and magenta stripes as one identity.

review.note: The original photograph and polygon-outline review were inspected. Floral ink of every colour belongs to one material; all horizontal printed stripes belong to the other. Conservative visible interiors avoid joins and edges. Physical paper/fabric composition is not asserted. Compiled overlays were inspected at 256 and 768 pixels; interiors retain the intended material and all uncertain joins and outer margins remain unlabelled. Follow-up review moved the centre floral polygon left vertex from [811,570] (inside an adjacent striped cell) to [849,535], safely inside the floral material.

subsetProvenance.policy: Unchanged annotation coordinates. Exclude complete currently QA-reserved source groups before rebuilding training labels. Current unassigned source groups drive fold closure.

scope: 24 assistant-reviewed real-photo candidates: the unchanged 16-instance encoder-tail subset plus eight diverse-paper instances. Source-separated from the current 32-photo development evaluation; motifs can recur and generalization is not established. Not a global train/test assignment.
